entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-09-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • CS9282: This member is not allowed in an extension block #80312
  • Compiler should be a bit more lenient with inferring collection types for inlined collection initializers. #80306
  • Nullable flow analysis for unmanaged pointers #80305
  • ErrorLog option changes which warnings are reported #80301
  • Include the assembly name when ambiguous methods are otherwise the same #80300
    Next Next
  • Unexpected error is reported when an added module contains an extension block #80294
    Next

Closed

  • Report error when Hot Reload attributes are applied manually #80106
  • Unexpected error when using Span defined with old ref safety rules #80244
    18.0
  • Compiler-generated collection class for collection expression is not debugger-friendly #80303
  • Compiler toolset package doesn't contain Linux executables (csc, vbc, VBCSCompiler) #80151
    Next

PullRequests

Created

  • Factor Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.Workspaces.Test.Framework for sharing #80315
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Ensure that top-level statements entry point emits MethodImplAttributes.Async #80314
    Area-Compilers
  • Properly populate ExportedType metadata table in presence of extension block. #80311
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything
  • Allow clients to send range ending at the line after the last line in the document #80310
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Pull publish data directly from branch #80308
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Add the ability to preload parts of the project system #80307
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Create fixer that inserts missing close braces and properly formats them. #80304
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Extensions: fix GetDocumentationCommentXml with netmodule #80297
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything

Merged

  • Change DocumentAnalysisExecutor to use ValueTask #80293
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Rename unified settings from "textEditor" to "language" #80309
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Report error when MetadataUpdateDeletedAttribute is applied manually #80125
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Reduce allocations in XmlDocumentationProvider.GetDocumentationForSymbol #80287
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Delete old workaround that's now obsolete #80286
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Reduce allocations in SourceTextStream ctor #80289
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Reduce allocations in InlayHintHandler.GetInlayHintsAsync #80284
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Reduce allocations in AnalyzerConfig.UnescapeSectionName #80288
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Do not make assumptions about content of erroneous BoundCall node based on value of InvokedAsExtensionMethod property #80256
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Next
  • Update the solution-explorer symbol-tree dropdown when a document has been explicitly opened. #80299
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Don't show Razor diagnostics in Full Solution Analysis #80296
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Remove CompilationPair abstraction in diagnostic analyzer subsystem #80141
    Area-Analyzers, Needs API Review, VSCode, Next
  • Track proposal id in copilot adjustment requests #80280
    Area-IDE, Next
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #80295
    Area-Compilers, Needs API Review, VSCode, Next
  • Fix 'GetRefEscape' for invocation using old rules #80261
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Remove fallback for obtaining file-based program XML when SDK is too old #80291
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Move package publishing out of Roslyn official build #80009
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Delete the old Intellisense option pages #80290
    Area-IDE, Needs UX Triage
  • Add friendlier error message on an explicit implementation when the return type is wrong #80267
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Use dotnet run file for generating compiler code #80248
    Area-Compilers
  • Remove CS1998 warning entirely and remove dependent C# code fix providers #80144
    Area-Compilers, VSCode, Feature - Runtime Async
  • Extensions: DocumentationCommentId and ExtensionGroupingName/ExtensionMarkerName APIs, update grouping type metadata name #80164
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, Needs API Review, VSCode
  • Reduce allocations in SourceGeneratedDocumentIdentity.Generate #80292
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Invoke Created action from HotReloadException constructor #79790
    Area-Compilers
  • Improve a check for inheritance relationship between types during binary operator re-inference in nullable walker #80272
    Area-Compilers
  • Do not allow loading analyzers within Visual Studio host #79865
    Area-IDE, VSCode
  • Allow `ToArray` optimization when resulting array can be implicitly reference-converted to the target array #80104
    Area-Compilers, Community
